evidence.verification_scope: Rule VI paragraphs (a) and (d), verbatim. Paragraphs (b) and (c) were never held verbatim in the public tree; their substance is carried by the public proposition.

Rule XXI, complete text, both paragraphs (a) and (b), as carried by the maintained CMI text. The superscript footnote marker on paragraph (b) is an editorial reference and is excluded from the passage; the footnote sentence itself is not part of the rule and is recorded in the instrument register rather than hashed here.
